messages:
Sasha Rivera: hi @people-ops - I need help with a recurring issue. My manager asked me to stop working from home twice a week because of "visibility" concerns. I submitted an informal request for a quiet workspace due to chronic migraines last month but haven't heard back. Can someone advise?
Marta (People Ops): thanks for flagging this, Sasha. sorry you're dealing with this. can you DM me the timeline? we'll start an accommodation intake and keep it confidential. do you have the intake form link?
Sasha Rivera: timeline: asked via email on 3/1, pinged manager on 3/8, got reply yesterday saying "visibility matters" and that my schedule has to be in-office on tuesdays/thursdays. migraines make morning commute unpredictable.
Jamal Khan: tagging Alex Lee to confirm the manager's ask — Alex, can you share context? also @marta, do we have an intake number already for sasha?
Alex Lee (mgr): Jamal - I asked about in-office because we had a few missed standups. I wasn't aware of a medical request. Sasha, didn't mean to cause stress — happy to pause changes while ops and you sort this.
Marta (People Ops): Sasha, here's the formal intake link: https://intranet.redwood/hr/accommodations-form (confidential). please fill this out; you can attach docs if you want but it's optional. once submitted we'll assign a case and set a triage call (30m) with you + manager + a people-ops rep. in the meantime, we recommend pausing any performance writeups related to schedule until the intake completes.
people-ops-bot: New accommodation intake created: case #AC-2029 (private). A People Ops rep will reach out within 48 hours.
Sasha Rivera: thanks, filled form. attaching short note from my doc. appreciate the pause on writeups.
Marta (People Ops): got it, I have the submission. scheduling triage for tomorrow 2pm PST, will send invite and an optional note template for manager. if anything urgent, DM me. :handshake:
